LoginPage.title: Business Manager
LoginPage.subtitle: Sign in to record sales and see how the day is going.
LoginPage.accountSwitchedOffDescription: An admin has removed access for this account. Any sales it already recorded are safe. Ask an admin to turn it back on.
LoginPage.forgotCodeStart: Forgot your code? Ask an admin to reset it for you from
LoginPage.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your name and the new password.

AdminHome.title: Home
AdminHome.noNotes: No notes yet. Staff can leave a message about the day, and you will get a notification.

AdminMenu.title: Menu & prices
AdminMenu.description: Set what you charge and roughly what each plate costs you. Those two numbers are what turn sales into profit figures.
AdminMenu.archivedBody: Dishes you take off the menu are kept here, so old reports still make sense.
AdminMenu.emptyBody: Add your first dish, with its price and roughly what it costs you to make.
AdminMenu.removeGroupBody: The dishes stay on the menu, they just lose this group.
AdminMenu.removeItemBody: It disappears from the till. Past sales keep it, and you can bring it back any time.
AdminMenu.dishSubtitle: The cost estimate is what drives your profit numbers.
AdminMenu.name: Name
AdminMenu.belowTarget: That is below your {pct}% target margin.
AdminMenu.availableHint: Turn off when you run out - it disappears from the till.
AdminMenu.pinTop: Pin to the top of the till
AdminMenu.pinHint: For the things you sell all day.
AdminMenu.groupSubtitle: Groups are the tabs staff use to find things quickly.
AdminMenu.bumpSubtitle: For when market prices move across the board.
AdminMenu.bumpHint: Use a negative number if things got cheaper. Prices are not touched.
AdminMenu.bumpNote: This only changes future sales. Everything already recorded keeps the cost that applied when it was sold.

AdminExpenses.title: Money out
AdminExpenses.description: Everything you spend, and how it lands on each day's profit.
AdminExpenses.costingAuto: Estimates, overridden where you recorded real food cost
AdminExpenses.spentSubtitle: {allocated} of expenses, plus {estimated} of estimated food cost
AdminExpenses.noExpenses: No expenses touched this period yet.
AdminExpenses.runningPerDayBody: This is what your repeating expenses add up to for a single day. You need to take at least this much, before food cost, just to break even.
AdminExpenses.overrideButItem: An expense is marked as replacing your per-plate estimates, but costing is set to estimates only in Settings - so it is being counted as an ordinary running cost instead.
AdminExpenses.overrideActive: Food cost is coming from your recorded expenses, not the per-plate estimates, for the days those expenses cover.
AdminExpenses.emptyBody: Add rent, salaries, gas, or a market run. Recurring ones only need entering once.
AdminExpenses.deleteBody: It will stop counting towards your costs, in every period it touched.
AdminExpenses.whatForPlaceholder: e.g. Rent, Market run, Cooking gas
AdminExpenses.overrideLabel: This is what the food actually cost
AdminExpenses.overrideDescription: Use this amount instead of the per-plate estimates for the days it covers.
AdminExpenses.overrideExplain: For those days, profit becomes revenue minus this amount minus your other running costs. The per-plate estimates are ignored, so you get real numbers without editing every dish. Per-dish profit still uses the estimates, because that is the only per-dish information there is.
AdminExpenses.notePlaceholder: e.g. bought at Merkato, prices up this week
AdminExpenses.helpDaily: Counted in full on every day from the start date.
AdminExpenses.helpWeekly: Spread as one seventh per day, so weekly and monthly reports agree.
AdminExpenses.helpMonthly: Spread across the days of each month.

OfflinePage.title: This page needs internet
OfflinePage.description: You have not opened this screen on this phone before, so there is no saved copy of it yet.
OfflinePage.footer: Anything you already recorded is safe on this phone and will be sent on its own as soon as there is a signal.

ShopPage.subtitle: Not set up yet
ShopPage.isNextDesc: The restaurant side is finished and in use. The shop needs a few things the restaurant does not, so it is being built second rather than half-built now.
ShopPage.stockDesc: Phones and accessories are individual pieces, not plates you can cook again. Selling one has to reduce what is left, and warn you before you run out.
ShopPage.cost: Cost per piece, not per recipe
ShopPage.costDesc: Profit comes from what you paid the supplier for that exact item, so each piece carries its own buying price rather than an estimate.
ShopPage.repairsDesc: Repair jobs, deposits taken, and serial numbers for warranty questions.
ShopPage.sharedDesc: Everything already built is shared: sign-in, offline recording, sync, notifications, notes and the reporting engine all understand a second business. Adding the shop is new screens, not a new app.

Till.noMenuOffline: The menu has not reached this phone yet. Connect to the internet once and it will be saved here for offline use.
Till.noMenuAdmin: An admin needs to add food items before you can record sales.
Till.nothingMatchesBody: Try a different word or pick another category.
Till.staleMenu: This menu was last updated over a day ago. Prices may have changed.
Till.pausedBody: An admin has paused your ability to record sales. You can still look at the menu and your past sales, and anything you already saved is safe.
Till.pausedToast: An admin has paused your ability to record sales. Please speak to them.
Till.orderSubtitle: {items, plural, =1 {# item} other {# items}} - {lines, plural, =1 {# line} other {# lines}}
Till.noteHint: Optional - the admin will see this
Till.noInternetNote: No internet right now - it is stored safely and sent later.
Till.savedOfflineBody: It will be sent automatically when you have internet. You can keep selling.
Till.moreWaysSubtitle: Banks, mobile money and anything else

Shift.pendingBody: still on this phone. They are safe and will be sent automatically.
Shift.emptyBody: Orders you save appear here straight away, online or not.
Shift.rejectedNote: The office could not accept this one. Open the sync status at the top of the screen to see why.
Shift.footer: Every sale you record is kept for your account, so this list follows you to any phone. The office sees the full picture from every device.
Shift.voidedNote: A manager cancelled this sale. It is not counted in the day's takings.

Shell.updateBody: It will be applied the next time you open the app.

Sync.needsYou: {count, plural, =1 {# needs you} other {# need you}}
Sync.yourDataSubtitle: Nothing is ever deleted before the database confirms it.
Sync.allInDatabase: Everything you have recorded is in the database. You can close the app safely.
Sync.storedOnPhone: These records are stored on this phone. They will be sent automatically as soon as there is internet - you do not need to keep the app open.
Sync.noRejectedBody: If the server ever refuses something, it will appear here instead of disappearing.
Sync.rejectedCount: {count, plural, =1 {# record the server refused} other {# records the server refused}}
Sync.discardBody: will be deleted from this phone and will never reach the database. This cannot be undone.
Sync.offlineToastBody: Keep working - everything is saved on this phone and sent when the signal returns.
Sync.syncedBody: {count, plural, =1 {# record} other {# records}} sent to the database.
Sync.signInAgainBody: Your session expired. Nothing was lost - your records are still on this phone.
Sync.pausedBody: An admin has paused your ability to record. Nothing you saved is lost.

ChangeCode.chooseSubtitle: Welcome, {name}. Pick a 6-digit code only you know - you will use it every time you sign in.
ChangeCode.mismatch: The two new codes do not match.
ChangeCode.hint: Avoid your birthday or six identical digits.

AdminSettings.businessSubtitle: Names, money and the trading day
AdminSettings.dayStartsAt: A new trading day starts at
AdminSettings.dayStartsHint: Sales rung up before this hour count towards the night before. Useful if you serve past midnight.
AdminSettings.lowMarginLabel: Warn me when a dish keeps less than
AdminSettings.lowMarginHint: Dishes below this margin are flagged in red.
AdminSettings.costingQuestion: How should profit be worked out?
AdminSettings.costingAutoBody: Use your per-plate cost estimates day to day. On any day covered by an expense you marked as “this is what the food actually cost”, use that real figure instead. Recommended.
AdminSettings.costingItemBody: Food cost always comes from the estimate on each dish. Expenses - including ones marked as replacing estimates - are treated as ordinary running costs on top.
AdminSettings.costingPeriodBody: Ignore the per-plate estimates entirely for overall profit. Only money you actually recorded as an expense counts as cost. Per-dish profit still uses the estimates, because nothing else exists per dish.
AdminSettings.notificationsSubtitle: What should reach your phone, and when
AdminSettings.needsInstall: On iPhone, add this app to your home screen first, then open it from there to allow notifications.
AdminSettings.unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications. Everything is still recorded in the bell menu.
AdminSettings.notificationsOff: Notifications are off on this device
AdminSettings.onSaleHint: One notification per batch that arrives, not one per plate.
AdminSettings.onOffline: When offline sales come in late
AdminSettings.onOfflineHint: Tells you a phone reconnected and sent work it had been holding.
AdminSettings.onNoteHint: Problems always notify, whatever this is set to.
AdminSettings.saleMinLabel: Only tell me about single sales of at least
AdminSettings.saleMinHint: Set to {zero} to be told about every sale. Batches always notify.
AdminSettings.sendFirstBody: Clearing now would throw away work that has not reached the database.
AdminSettings.clearCache: Clear cached pages on this device
AdminSettings.clearNote: Clearing only removes copies of pages. Sales waiting to be sent are kept separately and are never touched by this.
AdminSettings.pageSubtitle: How the business is set up and how profit is worked out.

AdminDigest.title: Nightly summary
AdminDigest.subtitle: Revenue, cost, profit and the best dishes, sent every night
AdminDigest.enableHint: One message with the day's takings, costs, profit and best sellers.
AdminDigest.skipEmpty: Stay quiet on days with no sales
AdminDigest.sendAtHint: Local time in {tz}. On a plan that allows only one cron a day (Vercel Hobby), the time in vercel.json decides instead.
AdminDigest.pushNote: Goes to every admin who turned notifications on. No setup needed.
AdminDigest.telegramGoingTo: Going to {count, plural, =1 {# chat} other {# chats}}. The same bot also answers questions on demand.
AdminDigest.telegramNote: The main channel. Recipients are set in the environment, not here.
AdminDigest.emailNote: Optional, over SMTP. Useful if you want a written record you can search later.
AdminDigest.notAvailable: Not available yet — set {vars} on the server.
AdminDigest.sendNowNote: “Send now” ignores the once-a-night rule so you can test it. The real send happens even with nobody in the app, and can only go out once per day per channel.
AdminDigest.botBody: The same bot answers questions any time: today's takings, the week, best dishes, costs, notes, what is sold out. It can only read — recording sales, prices, expenses and access all stay in this app.
AdminDigest.chatsAllowed: {count, plural, =1 {# chat} other {# chats}} allowed to use the bot

AdminTeam.title: Team & codes
AdminTeam.description: Who can sign in, what they can see, and their sign-in codes.
AdminTeam.ordersIn30: {count, plural, =1 {# order} other {# orders}} in 30 days
AdminTeam.accessFootnote: A change applies the next time that phone does anything - it does not wait for them to sign out. Anything they already recorded is always kept and still syncs.
AdminTeam.accessSubtitle: Takes effect immediately, on every device they use.
AdminTeam.selfLocked: This is your own account. Ask the other admin to change your access - the app will not let you lock yourself out.
AdminTeam.lastAdminLocked: This is the last admin with full access. Give somebody else full admin access first, otherwise nobody could get back in.
AdminTeam.deleteNoteWithOrders: Deleting the account cannot be undone. Their orders are kept, but {count, plural, =1 {# past order} other {# past orders}} would stop showing their name. Choosing No access above keeps the name on the history and is almost always the better choice.
AdminTeam.deleteNoteNoOrders: Deleting the account cannot be undone. They would no longer appear anywhere. Choosing No access above keeps them on the history and is almost always the better choice.
AdminTeam.deleteBodyWithOrders: This cannot be undone. {count, plural, =1 {# past order} other {# past orders}} will stay in your records but will no longer show who recorded it.
AdminTeam.addSubtitle: They get a 6-digit code you can give them.
AdminTeam.name: Name
AdminTeam.nameHint: This is what they type to sign in.
AdminTeam.newStaffNote: They will be able to record sales on the till and see their own shift. They never see costs, profit, or anybody else's numbers. You can make somebody an admin later by editing their account.
AdminTeam.staffCapability: The till and their own sales. They never see costs, profit or other people's numbers.
AdminTeam.adminCapability: Full access: reports, expenses, menu, team, and notifications.
AdminTeam.codeSubtitle: They will be asked to change it when they sign in.
AdminTeam.randomNote: A random 6-digit code will be generated and shown to you once.
AdminTeam.needsThisCode: {name} needs this code to sign in
AdminTeam.couldNotCopy: Could not copy - please write it down
AdminTeam.codeNotStored: This code is not stored anywhere you can read it again. If it gets lost, generate a new one.
AdminTeam.pageSubtitle: Who can sign in, what they can see, and their sign-in codes.

full.label: Full access
full.description: Can sign in and record sales.

read_only.label: Read only
read_only.description: Can sign in and see their own history, but cannot record anything.

blocked.label: No access
blocked.description: Cannot sign in. Their past sales are kept.

AdminReports.title: Reports
AdminReports.dishesSold: {count, plural, one {# dish sold in this period} other {# dishes sold in this period}}
AdminReports.rankedProfit: Ranked by what is left after the per-plate cost estimate.
AdminReports.rankedQty: Ranked by how many went out of the kitchen.
AdminReports.thinnestSubtitle: Selling well but keeping little - candidates for a price or recipe review
AdminReports.busiestSubtitle: Revenue by hour of the day, across the whole period
AdminReports.bestDaysSubtitle: Average takings on each weekday in this period
AdminReports.nothingSoldSubtitle: {count, plural, one {# item on the menu with no sales in this period} other {# items on the menu with no sales in this period}}
AdminReports.footnote: Per-dish profit uses your cost estimates. Overall profit also includes running costs, and your recorded food spend where you marked it as replacing the estimates.
AdminReports.ordersItems: {orders, plural, =1 {# order} other {# orders}} - {items, plural, =1 {# item} other {# items}}
AdminReports.winnersSubtitle: Top {n} by money in, compared with their place over the {baseline}
AdminReports.winnersFootnote: The arrow shows how many places a dish moves compared with its {baseline} position. A green arrow means it is doing better lately than it usually does.
AdminReports.noSalesBody: Once staff record orders, your best and worst dishes appear here.

Summary.dayByDaySubtitle: Bars are what came in; the line is what you kept
Summary.overrideNote: Food cost for this period comes from the expenses you recorded ({amount}), not from the per-plate estimates. Your estimates would have said {estimate}.
Summary.itemModeNote: Costing is set to per-plate estimates, so your “replace estimates” expenses are being counted as ordinary running costs.
Summary.ordersItems: {orders, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} - {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}

ErrorPage.title: Something went wrong
ErrorPage.body: This screen could not be shown. Trying again usually fixes it.
ErrorPage.offlineBody: This screen needs the internet to load. It will work again as soon as you have signal.
ErrorPage.dataSafe: Nothing you recorded has been lost. Sales saved on this phone are still waiting to be sent.

NotFoundPage.body: That link does not go anywhere any more.

Profile.pageSubtitle: Your name, picture and how you sign in. These need internet - offline recording starts once you are signed in.
Profile.setupBody: Replace the code you were given with a password only you know, and add your email so you can reset it yourself if you ever forget.
Profile.youSubtitle: How your name appears on every sale you record
Profile.name: Name
Profile.nameHint: This is also what you type to sign in.
Profile.emailHint: Only used to send you a reset link if you forget your password. Admins only.
Profile.passwordSubtitle: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number
Profile.codeSubtitle: Six digits, typed every time you sign in
Profile.noEmailWarning: You have not added an email yet. Without one there is no way to reset your own password if you forget it - you would need the other admin to do it for you.

Notifications.title: Notifications
Notifications.nothingYetBody: When staff record a sale or leave a note, it will show up here.
Notifications.needsInstall: To get notifications on iPhone, first add this app to your home screen, then open it from there.
Notifications.unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications. The list below still records everything.
Notifications.onForDevice: Phone notifications are on for this device.
Notifications.pitchTitle: Get told the moment a sale is recorded
Notifications.pitchBody: Works even when the app is closed. One notification per batch, not one per plate.

SalesLog.search: Search by dish, staff or table...
SalesLog.nothingRecorded: Nothing has been recorded for this period.
SalesLog.putBack: Put it back in the totals
SalesLog.cancelExplain: The order stays in the log with your reason attached, but it stops counting towards revenue and profit. Nothing is deleted.

Reset.mailNotConfigured: Email is not set up on this server yet, so reset links cannot be sent. Ask the other admin to reset your password from Team.
Reset.checkInbox: Check your inbox, and the spam folder if it is not there. The link works once.
Reset.adminEmailHint: The address saved on your profile.
Reset.staffNote: Staff do not have an email here. If you record sales, ask an admin to reset your code from <team>Team</team>.
Reset.newPasswordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
Reset.expired: That link has expired. Reset links last 45 minutes.
Reset.alreadyUsed: That link has already been used.

Notes.pageSubtitle: Everyone in the family can read these
Notes.willReachOffice: It will reach the office when you have internet.
Notes.postingPaused: An admin has paused your ability to post. You can still read everything here.
Notes.noNotesBody: Use this for anything worth remembering: a complaint, a delivery that was short, a message for the family.
Notes.headerSubtitle: Everyone in the family can read these
